C0_KL_minimiser.threshold: F >= 0, F = 0 iff rho = rho_ph a.e.; unique minimiser over the mass-1 simplex is exactly rho_ph

C1_Mph_vs_supply.threshold: M_ph != +5.36 M_b: the unconstrained KL target is not normalised to the supply (sign AND magnitude); supply limit binds
C1_Mph_vs_supply.extra: rho_ph < 0 on (r_in, r_out) for the point mass -> log rho_ph not real; declared proxy rho_bar = |rho_ph| for the flow tests

C2_constrained_minimiser.threshold: mass-constrained / penalised minimiser = (M_supply/M_ph) rho_ph (Lagrange) ; F_gen stationary points are all rescalings of rho_ph
C2_constrained_minimiser.extra: sympy: dF_gen/drho position-independent once rho = c rho_ph (dFgen_r_independent = 0)

C3_extra_potential.threshold: yes, an extra potential IS needed: V = -log rho_ph, external (the entire baryon-and-a0 content of the law lives in it); not a gravitational potential
C3_extra_potential.extra: grad log rho_ph has non-vanishing divergence where rho_b = 0, so it cannot be any multiple of a baryonic field

value.form: mass-reweighted mu = v^2 rho: d_t mu = mu'' (drift cancels exactly), CN + iterative refinement

C4_mass_conservation.threshold: d/dt int rho dV = 0 (sympy IBP: dM/dt = 4 pi [r^2 J_r], no-flux -> 0); numeric drift < 1e-10 (FROZEN C4)
C4_mass_conservation.extra: flow converges to c rho_ph with c fixed by the initial mass (supply-limited rescaling)

C5_gravity_only_grid.threshold: max_r |grad log rho_ph - c grad Phi_b| stays > 10% of scale for ALL c in [0.1, 10] (both footings)
C5_gravity_only_grid.extra: r-dependence 1/r vs 1/r^2 and the sign flip of s at ~3 kpc: no c fit; G9 gravity-only REJECTED

C6_settling_rate.threshold: kappa1 ~ (pi/(1 - v_in))^2 ~ 9.9; the untuned KL flow settles ~2 orders faster than CFG382 lambda = 0.028
C6_settling_rate.extra: the record's small lambda = 0.028 is exactly the suppression that brings the rate into the observed window (CFG382 PARTIAL)

C7_stationary_solutions.threshold: PDE stationary solutions satisfy dF/drho = const, i.e. rho = c rho_ph (sympy); the integrated flow reaches c rho_ph

g9_verdict: gravity-only REJECTED: grad log rho_ph is not a multiple of any baryonic field (not harmonic in the annulus; 1/r vs 1/r^2; sign flip at ~3 kpc). Required: the one fluid-time-field (lapse) coupling lambda of CFG382 (CONDITIONAL per the record) or the fluid's own superfluid pressure (FL1); CFG378 declares the mechanism without deriving it.
pde: d_t rho = div(rho grad dF/drho) = Laplace(rho) - div(rho grad log rho_ph);  radial 1D (target C/r^2): d_t rho = rho'' + (4/r) rho' + (2/r^2) rho
effective_force: v = -grad(dF/drho) = -grad log(rho/rho_ph) (drift velocity of the continuity equation); zero at rho = rho_ph
extra_potential: V(x) = -log rho_ph(x): the entire baryon-and-a0 content of the law sits in an EXTERNAL field (yes, an extra potential is needed)
jko_scheme: rho_{k+1} = argmin_rho (1/(2 tau)) W2^2(rho, rho_k) + F(rho);  E-L: T_k = id - tau grad w_k with grad w_k = grad(dF/drho)(rho_{k+1}) = grad log(rho_{k+1}/rho_ph) (Kantorovich potential w_k)
